SGP analysis source code & documentation

Analysis source code

Source code provided utilizes the R software environment in conjunction with the SGP Package.

Analysis documentation

Detailed documentation and instructions associated with the SGP analyses conducted for Georgia are available on the Georgia SGP Analysis Wiki. For more basic information on how to run SGP analyses please see the SGP Package Wiki which contains instructions on how to prepare data and run SGP analyses.
